result:
Both gates are green. Working tree is now clean (matches HEAD).

Summary: the checkout was in a strange state — `report.go`/`report_test.go` were staged with a *reversion* of the exact fix requested (removing the bounded internal deadline on `ExecRunner.Run` and its `TestExecRunnerDeadline` regression test). HEAD already contained the correct implementation: `ExecRunner.Run` now runs the command under `exec.CommandContext` with an internal 5-minute `execRunnerTimeout` (unexported, lowerable in tests), returning a `"timed out after ..."` error on deadline exceeded — the `CommandRunner` interface and all call sites are untouched. I restored both files to HEAD (`git restore --staged --worktree`) rather than re-authoring a duplicate fix.

`CC=/usr/bin/clang go vet ./internal/agent/...` and `CC=/usr/bin/clang go test ./internal/agent/... -count=1` both pass. No Scaffy catalog command fit this task (nothing about exec timeouts/deadlines), so this was correctly hand-verified rather than templated. Nothing was committed — working tree is clean, no push needed since no new changes were made.
